title: Lens
content: A lens is a transparent material which can converge or diverge rays of light and has at least one curved surface.

title: Convex Lens
content: A convex lens is a lens which can converge the parallel rays.

title: Concave Lens
content: A concave lens is a lens which can diverge the parallel rays.

title: Principal Axis of a Lens
content: The principal axis of a lens is the line joining the centres of curvature of two surfaces.

title: Optical Centre of a Lens
content: The optical centre of a lens is a point in the middle of a symmetric lens on the principal axis.

title: Magnification
content: Magnification is the ratio of the height of the image to the height of the object.

title: Power of a Lens
content: The power of a lens is inversely proportional to the focal length of the lens.
